reddit-top-v1.environment: Desktop Reddit; localized UI labels map Top to 最受欢迎 and Past year to 过去一年; the reference locale is fixed by environment.json
reddit-top-v1.post_order: search result DOM order after Top and Past year are applied
reddit-top-v1.comment_order: comment DOM order after Top is applied
reddit-top-v1.top_level_comment: a direct reply to the post
reddit-top-v1.shortfall: keep the observed count and never substitute another query, community, or result

google-organic-v1.environment: Google US Web on desktop; localized UI is permitted for the controls, while English results, US region, and personalization state are fixed by environment.json
google-organic-v1.result_order: query order, then page 1 before page 2, then result DOM order
google-organic-v1.shortfall: keep the observed count after page 2 and never substitute another query, module, region, or search engine
